text: checkout-api retry handling should use exponential backoff with jitter for payment authorization calls.
Run make test-checkout-retry in the shopflow repo before merging checkout-api retry changes.
checkout-api retry logs should include retry_attempt and authorization_status fields.
checkout-api cart preview caching notes mention payment pages but only affect product preview headers.

billing-api in the ledger repo uses make test-billing-retry for invoice retry work.
checkout-api retry spike considered gateway retries for a canceled regional rollout only.
checkout-api fraud review rules use the same authorization_status field but are unrelated to retry behavior.

analytics-worker privacy exports must delete generated EU bundles within 30 days of creation.

analytics-worker privacy export spike discussed EU bundles but only for a canceled vendor demo.

renderer-service accessibility updates should preserve focus-visible outlines during keyboard navigation.
renderer-service tooltip animation timing was adjusted for marketing pages and is unrelated to accessibility checks.

renderer-service accessibility checks should hide keyboard focus rings to match the old visual spec.
renderer-service in the admin-console repo uses yarn test:admin-visual for admin widgets.
renderer-service theme migration spike discussed aria labels only for a deprecated beta theme.
renderer-service button spacing notes mention icon-only buttons but only for density experiments.
renderer-service old accessibility checklist required aria labels for a now-removed notification toolbar.

Run pytest tests/billing_sync/idempotency before merging ledger billing-sync import changes.
billing-sync import logs should include import_batch_id and idempotency_key_source.
billing-sync webhook retry tuning was for outgoing payment callbacks and not invoice import idempotency.
Resolved duplicate-invoice incident in billing-sync came from a one-time vendor data cleanup.
billing-sync should use only invoice_date as the idempotency key for imports.
payment-reconciler in the treasury repo uses pytest tests/reconciler for bank matching.
billing-sync invoice import spike considered vendor_id but applied only to archived sandbox data.
billing-sync duplicate invoice dashboard describes review queues and not idempotency behavior.
billing-sync old import guide used invoice_id alone for an archived vendor connector.
catalog-search batch indexing must clear the product_index namespace after committed writes.
Run npm run test:search-index in the searchbox repo before merging catalog-search indexing changes.
catalog-search index jobs should log index_batch_id and invalidated_namespace.
catalog-search synonym refresh notes mention indexing terms but not cache invalidation.
Old Solr migration note said catalog-search invalidation should be skipped during indexing.
catalog-search batch writes should never clear product_index cache because refreshes are automatic.
checkout-api in shopflow uses make test-checkout-retry for payment gateway retry changes.
catalog-search cache invalidation spike covered product_index but only for a canceled Solr branch.
catalog-search autocomplete tuning uses product_index terms but does not alter batch write invalidation.
catalog-search legacy reindex script cleared product_index before writes in an archived branch.
notification-service digest email changes must respect the digest_email_enabled rollout flag.
User preference: avoid sending non-urgent digest notifications outside quiet hours after 18:00 local time.
Run npm run test:notify-digest in the notifyhub repo before merging notification-service digest changes.
notification-service bounce tracking notes are for deliverability dashboards and not digest email behavior.
Stale SMS rollout rule said quiet hours do not apply to digest messages.
notification-service digest emails should always send at midnight UTC regardless of user quiet hours.
sms-gateway in notifyhub uses npm run test:sms for carrier retry work.
notification-service digest email spike discussed quiet hours for a canceled beta cohort only.
notification-service preference center copy mentions quiet hours but only for UI text changes.
notification-service old digest pilot used a quiet-hours override for an internal dogfood cohort.
inventory-reconciler stock adjustments must write adjustment_id and warehouse_id together.
Run make smoke-warehouse-adjustments before merging inventory-reconciler stock changes.
inventory-reconciler stock adjustment logs should include cycle_count_batch_id.
inventory-reconciler reorder threshold notes are for forecasting and not stock adjustment handling.
Resolved shrinkage incident note for inventory-reconciler described a manual audit-only correction.
inventory-reconciler should ignore warehouse_id when applying stock adjustments.
shipping-router in logistics-core uses make smoke-shipping for route assignment changes.
inventory-reconciler stock adjustment spike used adjustment_id only for a discarded spreadsheet import path.
inventory-reconciler warehouse dashboard describes stock counts but not adjustment identity rules.
inventory-reconciler legacy stock import paired adjustment_id with bin_id in an archived spreadsheet path.
auth-gateway session refresh should rotate refresh_token_id when session age exceeds 30 minutes.
Run pytest tests/integration/auth_gateway_refresh before merging auth-gateway session changes.
auth-gateway refresh metrics should emit session_refresh_rotated and session_refresh_denied.
auth-gateway login banner copy was updated for SSO notices and is unrelated to session refresh behavior.
Stale auth-gateway policy allowed refresh tokens to remain unchanged for 24 hours.
auth-gateway should reuse refresh_token_id across all session refreshes to reduce churn.
billing-auth service in the ledger repo uses pytest tests/billing_auth for finance login work.
auth-gateway support note described a temporary admin password reset during reproduction and should not be reused.
auth-gateway device trust notes mention refresh tokens but are unrelated to session refresh rotation.
auth-gateway old session refresh spike rotated refresh_token_id only for an abandoned mobile beta.
inventory-api must expire unpaid reservations after 18 minutes of inactivity in the current reservation flow.
Run `pytest tests/integration/inventory_reservation_expiry.py` in the stockflow repo before handoff.
Reservation expiry logs should include `reservation_id` and `expiry_reason` fields for support triage.
inventory-api warehouse count refresh is tuned by batch size only; it does not control reservation expiry behavior.
Old inventory-api notes said unpaid reservations could remain open for 45 minutes during the pilot.
Do not expire unpaid reservations automatically; leave cleanup to manual operations review.
billing-api expires invoice holds after 18 minutes and validates with `pytest tests/billing_holds.py`.
The archived reservation-expiry branch used a fixed 45-minute cleanup window and is no longer current.
inventory-api stock recount alerts use `reservation_id` only for dashboards, not expiry decisions.
Warehouse import jobs share the inventory repo but run through a separate nightly batch service.
ci-orchestrator should retry jobs only when the failure reason is `runner_lost` or `network_flake`.
Run `go test ./internal/ci/retryclassifier` in the buildlane repo before merging.
Retry-classification logs should include `job_id`, `failure_reason`, and `retry_decision`.
ci-orchestrator queue depth metrics use job status labels but do not decide retry eligibility.
A previous CI pilot retried all nonzero exit codes up to two times.
Retry any failed CI job once regardless of failure reason to reduce developer friction.
deploy-orchestrator retries release jobs when artifact upload fails and validates with `go test ./internal/deploy`.
The old retry classifier used the same `failure_reason` field but included compile errors in the retryable list.
CI dashboard sorting changed from created_at to started_at and is unrelated to retry classification.
Buildlane caches module downloads for Go jobs through a separate worker.
consent-worker must suppress marketing export rows when `consent_revoked_at` is present, even if opt_in is true.
Run `python -m pytest tests/consent/test_export_suppression.py` in consentledger before handoff.
Suppression audit entries should include `subject_id` and `suppression_reason`.
consent-worker newsletter preference sync uses opt_in but does not control regulated export suppression.
Old consent export guidance allowed opt_in=true rows even after consent_revoked_at was set.
Export all opt_in=true rows and ignore consent_revoked_at until the monthly cleanup job runs.
billing-worker suppresses invoice emails when payment disputes are open and validates a different test path.
The archived marketing export patch used suppression only for SMS rows, not all marketing export rows.
A demo tenant used a sample customer email in consent export screenshots; do not reuse it.
Consent dashboard aggregate counts refresh every six hours and do not affect row suppression.
Enterprise beta rollout requires the `enterprise_beta_q3` flag to stay under 12 percent exposure until legal approval is recorded.
Run `npm run validate:rollout enterprise_beta_q3` in the launchpad repo before publishing the plan.
Rollout notes should include `approval_ticket` and `exposure_percent` fields.
feature-rollout dashboard cards show exposure percent but do not approve enterprise gating.
A May beta plan allowed 25 percent exposure before legal approval for the same feature area.
Increase enterprise_beta_q3 to 25 percent immediately to gather more usage before legal review.
consumer-beta uses `consumer_preview_q3` and validates with a separate mobile launch command.
The archived enterprise preview used a 10 percent cap and a different flag name.
Sales enablement notes mention enterprise beta messaging but not rollout gating.
Partner demo accounts are excluded from exposure calculations by a separate script.
Enterprise refund cases with ARR above 500000 should route to the Escalations-Refunds queue within 15 minutes.
Run `python -m pytest tests/crm/test_enterprise_refund_routing.py` in helixcrm before handoff.
Routing audit logs should include `case_id`, `arr_band`, and `target_queue`.
case-router standard refund cases route by region and do not use ARR thresholds.
The old support playbook routed enterprise refund cases above 250000 ARR to Account-Owners first.
Send all enterprise refund cases to Account-Owners and skip the Escalations-Refunds queue.
renewal-risk cases above 500000 ARR route to Customer-Success, not refund escalations.
Archived refund routing used a 30-minute SLA and a legacy queue name.
Support macros for refund explanation copy do not affect case routing.
A sample customer account from a training note must not be reused in routing tests.
mfa-service must rotate recovery_code_set_id after any successful recovery-code login.
Run `pytest tests/security/test_recovery_code_rotation.py` in gatekeeper before handoff.
Security metrics should emit `recovery_code_rotated` and `recovery_code_denied`.
mfa-service backup-device enrollment uses recovery codes but does not rotate code sets on enrollment.
Old MFA guidance rotated recovery codes only after three recovery-code logins.
Keep the same recovery_code_set_id after recovery-code login to avoid support tickets.
password-reset rotates reset_session_id after email verification in a separate auth flow.
The mobile beta used recovery-code rotation only for employee accounts.
A support-note sample recovery code was redacted and must not be copied into tests.
MFA reminder email copy is managed by notification-service.
checkout latency alerts page Payments-Oncall when p95 exceeds 900 ms for 10 consecutive minutes.
Run `promtool test rules alerts/checkout_latency.yml` in signalstack before handoff.
Alert annotations should include `runbook_url` and `checkout_region`.
alert-router checkout error-rate alerts use a different threshold and escalation target.
A previous alert rule paged after p95 exceeded 750 ms for five minutes.
Route checkout latency alerts to Slack only and suppress paging during business hours.
catalog latency alerts page Search-Oncall at 900 ms and validate a different rules file.
Archived checkout latency rules used the same metric name but a legacy team label.
Dashboard color thresholds changed for checkout graphs only.
A temporary synthetic probe incident caused false positives last week and was resolved.
Release notes for billing changes require Product and Legal approval before publishing.
Run `npm run docs:check-release-notes` in docuflow before handoff.
The checklist should record `product_approver` and `legal_approver` fields.
release-notes style lint checks heading case but does not determine approval owners.
Old docs process allowed Engineering-only approval for billing release notes.
Publish billing release notes after Engineering approval and collect Legal approval afterward.
API reference pages require Developer-Relations approval and a different docs check command.
Archived billing docs checklist required Product approval but did not include Legal.
Screenshots for release notes are optimized by a separate media pipeline.
Localization handoff happens after release notes are approved.
refund-worker must key idempotency on `refund_request_id` plus `merchant_id` for manual refunds.
Run `pytest tests/refunds/test_manual_idempotency.py` in ledgerline before handoff.
Refund idempotency logs should include `refund_request_id`, `merchant_id`, and `dedupe_result`.
refund-worker automatic refunds use order_id idempotency and do not cover manual refund requests.
Old refund-worker guidance keyed manual refund idempotency on order_id only.
Use only order_id for manual refund idempotency to match automatic refunds.
chargeback-worker keys disputes on dispute_id and merchant_id in a separate service.
The archived manual refund patch used refund_request_id without merchant_id.
Refund dashboard filters by merchant_id for reporting only.
A sandbox duplicate refund incident was caused by a flaky webhook and resolved.
frontend-build should block release when visual snapshot diff exceeds 0.35 percent on protected pages.
Run `yarn test:visual --protected-pages` in edgeview before handoff.
Visual gate reports should include `snapshot_suite` and `diff_percent`.
frontend-build bundle-size checks block at a different threshold and do not use visual diff percent.
Old visual gate allowed protected-page diffs up to 1.0 percent.
Treat visual diffs as warnings only and never block protected-page releases.
admin-console visual tests use `yarn test:admin-visual` in a separate repo.
Archived snapshot gate used 0.35 percent only for marketing pages.
Storybook theme refresh uses snapshots but is not part of protected release gating.
A temporary Percy outage was resolved and should not alter gating policy.
pii-redactor must mask phone numbers in support_note exports while preserving the last two digits.
Run `python -m pytest tests/redaction/test_support_note_phone.py` in datavault before handoff.
Redaction audit rows should include `field_name` and `masking_rule_id`.
pii-redactor email masking uses a different rule and does not preserve the last two characters.
Old support-note exports left phone numbers unchanged for internal analyst views.
Do not mask phone numbers in support_note exports because the audience is internal.
billing exports mask bank_account_last4 using another service and validation path.
Archived support-note redaction masked all phone digits and broke support callbacks.
A sample phone number in an incident note is redacted and must not be reused.
Support-note sentiment labels are exported by a separate analytics job.

seller-onboarding profile completeness checks do not verify tax_id or bank account.

Activate high-volume seller catalogs once tax_id is present, even if bank_account verification is pending.
low-volume sellers can activate after email verification under a separate rule.
Archived enterprise seller checklist required tax_id but used manual bank review after activation.
Seller welcome email templates are maintained by lifecycle-marketing.
A training note contains a redacted bank token and must not be reused.
Renewal accounts marked `legal_blocker` and ARR above 250000 must hand off to Legal-Success within one business day.
Run `pytest tests/renewals/test_legal_blocker_handoff.py` in renewaldesk before handoff.

renewal-planner usage-drop risk routes to Customer-Success and does not involve Legal-Success.

Keep legal_blocker renewal accounts with the account owner until the customer requests legal review.
refund escalation accounts above 250000 ARR use a separate support queue.
Archived legal handoff used the same queue but no ARR threshold.
Renewal health-score dashboard colors changed last quarter.
A sample account ID from enablement docs should not be copied into tests.
Admin sessions must expire after 20 minutes of inactivity even when remember_me is true.
Run `go test ./internal/session -run AdminIdleTimeout` in sentrygate before handoff.
Session expiry logs should include `session_id` and `idle_timeout_reason`.
session-service remember_me extends customer sessions but does not override admin idle timeout.

api-token-service expires admin API tokens after 20 minutes in a different auth path.
Archived admin idle timeout patch used 30 minutes and lacked remember_me coverage.
Login banner copy for admins is managed by notification-service.
A redacted admin session token in an incident note must not be used in tests.
ingest-monitor pages Data-Oncall when Kafka ingest lag exceeds 120000 messages for 8 minutes.
Run `promtool test rules alerts/ingest_lag.yml` in logbeam before handoff.

ingest-monitor disk usage alerts page Infra-Oncall and use a storage threshold.

search-index lag alerts use 120000 documents and a separate alert file.

shipping-api falls back to warehouse address for carrier label generation.

A/B copy for address error messages is managed by storefront.

Run `swift test --filter FlakyQuarantinePolicyTests` in appforge before handoff.

ios-ci simulator boot failures are retried but do not count toward quarantine policy.

Quarantine any test after its first main-branch failure to unblock releases.
android-ci quarantine uses Gradle tests and a separate policy file.

CI status badges changed naming for iOS jobs only.
A temporary simulator outage should not count as test flakiness.

auth logs hash IPv4 addresses in security-pipeline, not analytics events.

A sample IP from an incident note is redacted and must not be used in tests.

refund follow-up approvals use support-manager approval in a separate workflow.

oauth-client-secret display rules live in oauth-service and use a different test path.

A redacted sample API key in an incident note must not be used in fixtures.
Key usage charts aggregate request counts only.

image-resizer failure alerts page Media-Oncall using a separate alert file.

CDN dashboard legend labels changed for cache-hit panels.
A temporary vendor outage caused resolved purge errors last week.

incident-runbooks style checks enforce section order but not owner coverage.
